input_types: One UTF-8 JSON object with schema_version handoff-artifact-byte-check-r0 and a valid FederatedResultReceipt containing artifact refs, plus a separately supplied workspace-root CLI argument under ignition/; stdin is capped at 262144 bytes.
required_outputs: Per-artifact expected and observed SHA-256 statuses, byte counts, and typed read/path/size failures for bounded regular-file bytes; no file contents are returned.
